semantics.csv: UTF-8, CRLF, quoted fields. Formula-like text receives an apostrophe; unmodified evidence remains in snapshot.json.
semantics.zero: A numeric zero is an explicit value only when supported by accepted evidence.
semantics.percent: Independent reported value with explicit basis; never inferred from quantity.
semantics.baseline: Original activity baseline retained; newly added activity uses its first approved planned dates.
semantics.duration: Elapsed calendar days and inclusive working dates are separate. Working dates only for the stated Mon–Sat calendar; no productivity inference.
semantics.quantity: Cumulative projection, never add to a destination total.
semantics.emptyCells: Not recorded / not applicable. Never an instruction to clear a destination field.
semantics.milestones: Single occurrence with equal actual start/finish; zero working duration.
semantics.corrections: Evidence includes all accepted events; effective=false marks a superseded contribution. Snapshot is current accepted projection.

asOfMeaning: Capture date, not a filter on historical or synthetic future work dates
projectName: Urban Garbage Treatment Plant · Town XYZ
compatibility: Generic planner exchange. Native Primavera/P6 import not verified. Download is not external delivery.
